summary: The change raises the auto-approve DTI ceiling from 40% to 43% in code and in policy-params.json, but the approved obligation catalog on the base commit still fixes the approved value at 40%, so CRD-1 is violated. The prior exhaustive CRD-1 proof has lapsed because DTI_MAX_PERCENT changed, and the 'renewed' proof assumes DTI_MAX_PERCENT = 40, which is false at the head commit, so LAP-1 is not met. The ticket, independent review, control-owner approval and CI records are otherwise in order, but the two critical violations require rejection.
